turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Devon. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My order number is 9999 8888 7777 6666 and it hasn't shipped.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me look that up. That's a sixteen digit order reference, correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it's an order number, not a card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Found it. It shipped this morning, tracking follows by email.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh good. Also my confirmation code was one two three four five six.

labels.notes: Sixteen digits that are NOT a card (Luhn-invalid order number). Recall-biased policy still redacts it; this scenario measures the precision cost of that choice.
